summary_en: A young shopkeeper works hard and his fruit shop thrives — until he decides success means he can finally relax, with predictable results.

sentences.zh: 小张开了一家水果店。
sentences.en: Xiao Zhang opened a fruit shop.

sentences.zh: 水果店在市场旁边，不大，但是很干净。
sentences.en: The shop is next to the market — not big, but very clean.

sentences.zh: 一开始，没有什么顾客，小张很着急。
sentences.en: At first, there weren't many customers, and Xiao Zhang was anxious.

sentences.zh: 他决定每天早上去市场，自己挑选最好的水果。
sentences.en: He decided to go to the market himself every morning to pick the best fruit.

sentences.zh: 顾客来的时候，他总是笑着跟大家打招呼。
sentences.en: Whenever customers came, he always smiled and greeted everyone.

sentences.zh: 如果水果不新鲜，他就不卖。
sentences.en: If the fruit wasn't fresh, he wouldn't sell it.

sentences.zh: 慢慢地，来买水果的人越来越多。
sentences.en: Slowly, more and more people came to buy fruit.

sentences.zh: 大家都说，小张的水果最新鲜，价钱也公平。
sentences.en: Everyone said Xiao Zhang's fruit was freshest, and the prices were fair too.

sentences.zh: 他的生意一天比一天好，他也越来越高兴。
sentences.en: His business got better day by day, and he got happier and happier.

sentences.zh: 可是，过了半年，小张开始觉得很辛苦。
sentences.en: But after half a year, Xiao Zhang began to feel exhausted.

sentences.zh: 他想：“我已经这么努力了，生意已经很好了，休息几天应该没关系。”
sentences.en: He thought: "I've worked so hard already, business is already good — resting a few days should be fine."

sentences.zh: 他开始晚一点儿起床，也不去市场挑水果了。
sentences.en: He started getting up later, and stopped going to the market to pick fruit.

sentences.zh: 顾客来的时候，他也不像以前那样热情了。
sentences.en: When customers came, he also wasn't as warm as before.

sentences.zh: 水果的质量慢慢变得差了，可是小张没有注意。
sentences.en: The fruit's quality slowly got worse, but Xiao Zhang didn't notice.

sentences.zh: 过了一个月，他发现来买水果的人越来越少了。
sentences.en: A month later, he noticed fewer and fewer people were coming to buy fruit.

sentences.zh: 他很奇怪，去问旁边卖菜的邻居。
sentences.en: Confused, he went to ask his neighbor who sold vegetables next door.

sentences.zh: 邻居告诉他：“你的水果没有以前新鲜了，服务也没有以前好了。”
sentences.en: The neighbor told him: "Your fruit isn't as fresh as before, and your service isn't as good as before either."

sentences.zh: 小张听了，想了很久。
sentences.en: Xiao Zhang listened and thought for a long time.

sentences.zh: 他终于懂得了一个道理：生意好的时候，更要努力，不能只靠以前的运气。
sentences.en: He finally understood a lesson: when business is good, you must work even harder — you can't rely only on past luck.

sentences.zh: 第二天，他又像以前一样，早早起床，去市场挑选最好的水果。
sentences.en: The next day, he once again got up early like before and went to the market to pick the best fruit.

sentences.zh: 从这以后，他每天都认真工作，不再偷懒。
sentences.en: From then on, he worked hard every day and was never lazy again.

sentences.zh: 过了几个月，顾客又越来越多了。
sentences.en: A few months later, customers became more and more numerous again.

sentences.zh: 有一天，一个年轻人也想开一家水果店，来问小张怎么把生意做好。
sentences.en: One day, a young person who also wanted to open a fruit shop came to ask Xiao Zhang how to run a good business.

sentences.zh: 小张笑着说：“生意好的时候最容易骄傲，这时候千万不能放松。”
sentences.en: Xiao Zhang said with a smile: "It's easiest to become prideful when business is good — at that point you absolutely cannot relax."

sentences.zh: 年轻人点点头，说他记住了。
sentences.en: The young person nodded and said he would remember it.

sentences.zh: 后来，小张的水果店开了很多年，一直是市场里生意最好的一家。
sentences.en: Later, Xiao Zhang's fruit shop ran for many years, and was always the best-business shop in the market.

sentences.zh: 小张常常把这个故事讲给市场里新来的老板听。
sentences.en: Xiao Zhang often told this story to new shopkeepers in the market.

sentences.zh: 他的顾客说，这就是为什么他的店年年都是市场里最好的一家。
sentences.en: His customers said that was exactly why his shop stayed the best in the market, year after year.

grammar_points.explanation_en: "Day by day" — stacks a gradual change over time. 一天比一天好 is "better with each passing day".
grammar_points.example_en: The weather gets colder day by day.

grammar_points.explanation_en: 得 links a verb to how it is done. 变得差 is "became bad", describing the result of 变 (to change).
"Can't rely only on X" — 只靠 singles out the one thing someone is (wrongly) depending on.
grammar_points.example_zh: 学好中文不能只靠课本。
grammar_points.example_en: You can't learn Chinese well relying only on textbooks.

questions.q_zh: 一开始，小张的生意怎么样？
questions.q_en: How was Xiao Zhang's business at first?
questions.answer_en: Slow — there were not many customers, and he was anxious.

questions.q_zh: 生意变好以后，小张做了什么改变？
questions.q_en: What did Xiao Zhang change once business improved?
questions.answer_en: He got lazy — slept in, stopped picking fruit himself, and was less warm to customers.

questions.q_zh: 小张最后懂得了什么道理？
questions.q_en: What lesson does Xiao Zhang finally understand?
questions.answer_en: That when business is good you must work even harder, not coast on past luck.
